changesets.summary: Add syntax-aware automatic indentation for nested and incomplete SPARQL blocks, and align closing delimiters as they are typed (#16). Enable Tab/Shift+Tab indentation and Cmd+/ (macOS) or Ctrl+/ (Windows/Linux) to toggle `#` comments on the current line or all selected lines. Update the localized keyboard help and embedding documentation, including Escape then Tab to move focus out of the editor.
Rebuild the standalone Yasgui browser bundle with @ldforge/editor@1.5.2.
